Class SnapshotReader

java.lang.Object
edu.odu.cs.cs350.SnapshotReader
public class SnapshotReader extends Object
Locates and reads enrollment snapshot files. Finds CSV snapshot files from a given directory, reads their rows, and converts them into Section objects.
